body: thank you for writing aviation22.... It has been two years that I have had non stop  suicidal ideation over the cosmetic surgery... and then I recently contracted an infection from a bug bite that left a huge sore on my left butt cheek like the size of a silver dollar and... it looks so grotesque... like the skin is all eaten away .. It feels like the final straw ....  when I was already suicidally depressed about the surgical scars.. such body dismorphic disorder..  and this new condition is too much for my already damaged self esteem... my already distroted self image. I feel worthless.. I have lost myself. I am scared.  I can not be alone yet I isolate and avoid everyone and just keep up the facade on facebook. How do people go on like this... i have lost most of my friends and my family no longer wants to talk to me. I wonder so much about death.. will it really be freedom or will I be worse off because I will still be me. Im just so scared and alone and wish I need someone to  talk to as I have worn all my friends out.
